race.description: Slattery Grays Auctions Moree Town Plate
race.comment: CASTLEBAR ROAD (2) was quickly into stride and went on to score by a nose last time out at Dubbo to make it two on the bounce. Drawn to do the same and will prove tough to reel in again. INAZUMA BOY (1) is a consistent gelding resuming for the Northam yard. Was in terrific form last campaign and he returns in that sort of form he'll be right there at the business end. CRESTA RUN (9) hit the frame two starts ago at Muswellbrook but ran below par last time. Capable of bouncing back. GREY EFFECTS (11) placed a length back from the winner last time at Tuncurry on soft going and gets some weight relief, could sneak into the finish.
